issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling for missing license or API keys.
The setup assumes a Linux environment with apt and Node.js 22+, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: install-node-apm-agent
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fully satisfy the rubric by providing the npm install command, a newrelic.js file with the correct app_name and license key usage, and a code snippet that requires newrelic first.

scenarios.name: create-nrql-alert-condition
scenarios.rationale: Response B satisfies all rubric requirements while Response A does not include any GraphQL calls or the required NRQL condition.

scenarios.name: create-dashboard-nerdgraph
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric with the required GraphQL request and widgets, while Response B provides a Grafana dashboard instead of the specified New Relic GraphQL mutation.
